description: This 3D model displays a modern, minimalist bar stool rendered in a monochromatic white finish. The seat is cylindrical, featuring distinct vertical channel tufting or ribbed detailing, suggesting a padded and comfortable surface. It rests on a slender, cylindrical pedestal base, which typically indicates height adjustability. A circular footrest is integrated into the pedestal for user comfort. The stool is supported by a broad, flat, circular base, ensuring stability. The overall design is sleek and contemporary, devoid of any ornate decorations, emphasizing clean lines and functionality.
